notes: The ASV redistributes the possessors: 'A man's' is the lexical expression realizing the suffix on בִּטְנוֹ (rule 18) and 'his' realizes אִישׁ, the rectum of פִי, each morpheme staying with the noun it possesses.
The supplied 'With' before the bare nominal תְּבוּאַת states what it contributes to the clause and belongs to it (rule 33).
